image_description: A product shot of a box of 'Band-Aid' brand adhesive bandages featuring Angry Birds characters. The box is yellow and green with the 'BAND-AID' logo at the top. In front of the box, there is a fanned-out display of several individual bandage wrappers (blue packaging) and one unwrapped bandage lying flat. The unwrapped bandage has an orange/brown backing with a central white absorbent pad.
